cited_by.title: Hair types 4a, 4b, 4c: what typing tells you

record.population: Women of African descent, hairstyling and hair damage
record.finding: Highly textured hair is more susceptible to breakage because of an increased proportion of spirals and fewer elastic fibres anchoring follicles to the dermis; the review gives an overview of hairstyles so physicians can spot high-risk ones and suggest safer alternatives.
